title: CampaignSnapshot
description: The campaign's capital envelope and what it has already committed. Independent of the broker account: there is no field here for account equity.

budget.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

reserve.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

budget_source.description: CONFIG, or ENVIRONMENT when CAMPAIGN_BUDGET_EUR overrode the committed configuration. Recorded so a stored decision never implies configuration authorised a figure it does not contain.

realized_pnl_today.description: An amount, or null when it was never reported. Null is not zero: 'no buying power reported' and 'zero buying power' are different facts.

daily_pnl_status.description: How far the realised figure can be relied on (Milestone 11). TRACKED means every position that closed today produced a usable result. UNKNOWN means positions closed and at least one did not — an absence of knowledge about a day on which money moved, and emphatically not zero loss. NOT_TRACKED means no profit-and-loss ledger was consulted; it is the state of every snapshot written before Milestone 11, which is why it is the default.

unavailable_pnl_position_ids.description: Positions that closed today and produced no usable figure. Named rather than counted: 'which one' is the first question anybody asks of an unknown daily result.

allOf.description: A figure that is not trustworthy is not reported. A comfortable number next to 'we could not measure today' is exactly how an unmeasured day would pass a loss limit.
TRACKED means there is a real number.

money.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

nullable_money.description: An amount, or null when it was never reported. Null is not zero: 'no buying power reported' and 'zero buying power' are different facts.

campaign_position.description: Capital this campaign has already authorised for one opportunity. Not a broker position: an authorisation that was never executed still consumes budget.

capital_committed.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

max_loss.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.
